statement: You are given a singly linked list, listed head to tail in values, and an integer value.
Insert a new node holding value at the front of the list, so that it becomes the new head and its next pointer points to the old head.
Return the resulting list, read from the new head.

examples.explanation: A node holding 1 is created and pointed at the old head 2; none of the existing nodes move.
The new node 7 is linked in front of 8 and becomes the head.
